blocks.text:
> SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE for layout testing. Basis: GIPS Composite Report (Global Value Equity, data through 2025-12-31), verification letter dated 2026-03-15 and DDQ section 7. Diligence review against the 2020 GIPS standards; not a verification or legal opinion.



- **Overall assessment:** Satisfactory with follow-ups. The compliance claim is supported, but composite-scale
  and fee evidence need reconciliation [S1][S2][S3].

blocks.title: Key judgment — claim wording is supported
blocks.text: The firm-wide compliance statement follows the required wording in the reviewed report [S1]. This supports the presentation of the claim, but wording alone does not establish that every firm process, composite record and disclosure operated consistently during the covered periods.

blocks.title: Key judgment — latest year is outside verification
blocks.text: Verification covers 2015–2024 while the composite report extends through 2025 [S1, S2]. The latest reported year therefore sits outside the stated verification period, so readers should not infer verifier coverage for 2025 from the earlier opinion.

blocks.title: Key judgment — composite scale conflicts
blocks.text: The DDQ reports $2.4B of composite assets versus $2.1B in the year-end report [S1, S3]. The $0.3B difference remains unresolved because the records do not provide aligned effective dates or a reconciliation of flows and valuation changes.

blocks.title: Key judgment — fee basis is incomplete
blocks.text: The report describes management fees but does not identify the stated performance fee [S1]. This omission limits interpretation of net returns because the reviewed schedule does not establish whether that additional fee applies or how it is reflected.

blocks.title: Priority findings

items.title: Composite assets conflict
items.detail: The DDQ reports $2.4B while the GIPS Report reports $2.1B [S1, S3].

items.title: Fee schedule incomplete
items.detail: The reviewed fee disclosure omits the performance fee [S1].

blocks.empty_text: No High, Medium or Low findings were identified.

blocks.text:
Two Medium findings limit reliance on the supplied record: composite assets conflict across the DDQ and GIPS
Report, and the fee schedule does not identify the performance fee. Verification ends one year before the
latest report period, a Low finding [S1][S2][S3].

blocks.title: Analysis — composite scale is unresolved
blocks.text: **Observation:** Composite assets differ by $0.3B across two records [S1, S3]. **Why it matters:** Scale changes the context for the presented track record. **Uncertainty:** Effective dates and reconciliation records were not supplied. **What would change the view:** Follow-up request 1 producing a dated reconciliation.

blocks.title: Analysis — net-return fee basis is incomplete
blocks.text: **Observation:** One stated performance fee is absent from the schedule [S1]. **Why it matters:** Net-return interpretation depends on a complete fee basis. **Uncertainty:** The supplied report may omit a separately approved schedule. **What would change the view:** Follow-up request 2 producing approved fee records.

blocks.text:
### Performance Integrity & GIPS

**Overall assessment:** Satisfactory with follow-ups

**GIPS status:** Northfield claims compliance with the GIPS standards. Verified by Example Verifier LLP for 2015-01-01 to 2024-12-31. No performance examination of the composite. Report reviewed: Global Value Equity Composite, data through 2025-12-31.

**Key findings**
- [Medium] DDQ composite assets differ from the GIPS Report by $0.3B (1.A.7)
- [Medium] Fee schedule omits the performance fee (4.C.11)
- [Low] Verification gap of 12 months to the latest year-end

**Track record notes:** 11 years of annual returns, net of actual fees; global value equity benchmark; 14 portfolios; no carve-outs or portability.

**Follow-ups before approval**
1. Reconcile composite assets between the DDQ and the GIPS Report.
2. Provide the full fee schedule including the performance fee.

items.q: Provide a dated reconciliation of the $2.4B DDQ and $2.1B report composite assets.
Provide the complete fee schedule, including the performance fee.
Provide the current list of composite descriptions.
